digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 14 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 面向AI编码Agent的生产级工程技能库，让Agent直接复用资深工程师的实战经验与配置

repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: 统一大模型 API、内置 Agent 循环与 TUI 界面，还附带编码 Agent CLI，让 AI 工具链开发更高效

repos.name: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: 精选 Claude 技能与工具资源库，帮你定制 AI 工作流，让 Claude 更懂你的需求

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 一个统一API接入290+AI模型（含90+免费），支持Kimi、Claude、GPT等主流模型，兼容Claude Code、Cursor等编码工具，彻底解决多模型切换与调用门槛

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管 AI 伴侣容器，支持实时语音与 Minecraft 交互，将虚拟灵魂带入现实世界

repos.name: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx
repos.description: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
repos.summary_zh: 自建无纸化文档管理利器，自动扫描、OCR识别与归档，让纸质文件秒变可搜索数字档案

repos.name: DioxusLabs/dioxus
repos.description: Fullstack app framework for web, desktop, and mobile.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的跨端全栈框架，一套代码同时编译到 Web、桌面和移动端，性能接近原生

repos.name: microsoft/graphrag
repos.description: A modular graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system
repos.summary_zh: 基于知识图谱的检索增强生成系统，通过模块化图结构提升复杂信息推理与多跳问答的准确性和可解释性

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: jmerelnyc/Talos
repos.description: GPU worker client for the Talos network. Pairs with your Talos account, serves open-model inference jobs over a WebSocket, and reports uptime for payo
repos.summary_zh: 用闲置GPU接入Talos网络跑开源模型推理赚收益，WebSocket实时任务调度+在线时长计费

repos.name: xiaol/wkvm
repos.description: Inference for hybrid LLMs: Gemma, RWKV, and all kinds of hybrids.
repos.summary_zh: 混合LLM推理引擎，专为Gemma、RWKV等异构模型设计，解决混合架构部署难题

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 在 2GB 内存的 M 系列 MacBook 上运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 推理，让大模型本地部署门槛降到极致

repos.name: zeraix/zeraix
repos.description: Open-source local AI workspace — advancing on-device inference.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 优化的本地 AI 工作空间，让大模型在设备端高效推理运行

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，精准定位模型在颜色、纹理等基础视觉任务上的能力短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: koala73/worldmonitor
repos.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational aw
repos.summary_zh: 实时全球情报仪表盘，AI聚合新闻与地缘政治监控，统一界面追踪关键基础设施动态

repos.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 从零构建AI工程全流程的实战教程，用Python手写核心模块，助你真正掌握AI系统落地能力

repos.name: Effect-TS/effect
repos.description: Build production-ready applications in TypeScript
repos.summary_zh: TypeScript 原生函数式编程框架，用纯函数与类型安全解决复杂异步与错误处理，让代码更健壮可维护

repos.name: tonhowtf/omniget
repos.description: Download Udemy and Hotmart courses, YouTube videos, music and books — 1,800+ sites, no terminal. Free open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and L
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台开源下载神器，免终端抓取1800+网站视频课程与电子书，内置播放器和阅读器

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现无摄像头的人体感知、生命体征监测与空间定位，隐私安全且零视频像素

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 自建轻量 Bitwarden 密码管理器后端，资源占用极低，适合自托管且官方不提供官方服务的场景

repos.name: jamiepine/voicebox
repos.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI语音工作室，支持声音克隆与语音生成，让零门槛创建专属语音成为可能

repos.name: vnpy/vnpy
repos.description: 基于Python的开源量化交易平台开发框架
repos.summary_zh: 全功能量化交易框架，从策略回测到实盘交易一站式解决，支持全球主流交易所接口

papers.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary_zh: 提出轨迹中继在线蒸馏方法，通过纠正学生模型前缀偏差使推理准确率提升12%，同时保持在线蒸馏的监督一致性

papers.title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act through desktop GUIs to complete long-horizon tasks. Current benchmarks primarily measure end-task success or single-frame grounding. Neither isolates wheth
papers.summary_zh: 提出桌面GUI状态转换理解基准Desktop-Delta Bench，发现当前模型在因果动作重建任务上准确率不足60%，揭示关键能力短板

papers.title: Reinformed Dreamer: An Asymmetric World Model Efficiently Trained through Latent Guidance
papers.abstract: Much like humans benefit from guidance while learning, reinforcement learning algorithms may benefit from additional supervision beyond rewards. Leveraging additional information during training to le
papers.summary_zh: 提出非对称世界模型Reinformed Dreamer，通过潜在引导高效训练，在DMControl任务中样本效率提升2倍且性能超越DreamerV3

papers.title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Reuse Human Syntax More Than Humans Do
papers.abstract: Syntactic convergence (the tendency of speakers to adapt in language towards the grammatical profiles of their interlocutors) is a well-documented feature of human dialogue widely considered to operat

papers.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Muon: Robustness under the Spectral Norm

papers.summary_zh: 提出基于谱范数的锐度感知最小化方法，结合Muon优化器提升泛化鲁棒性，在多个基准上实现更优收敛与抗扰动性能

papers.title: Does Runtime Topology Context Improve LLM-Generated Kubernetes Security Patches?
papers.abstract: Kubernetes is central to the cloud-native ecosystem, orchestrating containerised workloads. Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can automate cluster security remediation, generating
papers.summary_zh: 通过引入运行时拓扑上下文增强LLM生成的Kubernetes安全补丁，在真实集群测试中修复准确率提升22%，误报率降低35%

papers.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies increasingly take the form of action-chunking flow policies built on large pretrained backbones. Such chunks run open-loop, so the policy cannot react to sensory input

papers.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
papers.abstract: We present VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. VetClaw uses a camera module as an edge sensing device and sends captured images, together with opti
papers.summary_zh: 提出边缘-云协同多模态智能体系统VetClaw，利用摄像头边缘感知与云端视觉语言模型实现零样本疾病分类，无需训练即可筛查宠物疾病

papers.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer
papers.abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for transferring knowledge across graph domains and tasks. Real-world graphs associate nodes with text, images, and other modalities

papers.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation

papers.summary_zh: 提出并行解码蒸馏框架，将视频扩散模型采样步数从50步降至2步，在保持质量的同时实现近25倍加速

papers.title: Falling Behind Drives Unsafe Development in an Idealised AI Race Experiment

papers.title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) route every token to a fixed number of experts $k$. Tokens differ in how uncertain the model is about them, so a single k over-spends on
papers.summary_zh: 提出置信度自适应路由机制使每个token按模型不确定性动态分配专家数量在多个基准上以更少计算量超越固定k路由方法

papers.title: Re-thinking Mammography Transfer Learning: The Dataset-Informed Transfer Learning (DITL) Framework for Breast Cancer Screening and Lesion Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Enhancing classification performance in mammography remains a persistent challenge across both small curated datasets and large-scale clinical cohorts. Conventional transfer learning approaches often
papers.summary_zh: 提出数据集知情迁移学习框架，在乳腺钼靶筛查中AUC达0.93，病灶诊断AUC达0.91，优于传统迁移与邻域方法

papers.title: Empirical Evaluation of Out-Of-Distribution Performance of Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as novel approaches for tabular predictive tasks, demonstrating competitive predictive performance to ensemble tree-based models. Most TFMs are trained an
papers.summary_zh: 系统评估八种表格基础模型在分布外场景下的性能，发现其鲁棒性普遍弱于树集成模型，平均准确率下降12%且校准误差增大
